name: Acarigua
discoveryMethod: First-party English and Venezuelan Spanish discovery, municipal custodian review, and bounded anonymous GET inspection of official pages/routes.
queryOutcomes: English discovery found the official Páez municipal cadastral page and national IGVSB site. Spanish discovery confirmed the same local cadastral custodian and its stated services. The municipal page contains no parcel viewer/API links. IGVSB Mapoteca and cartographic routes were reachable or partially reachable but did not expose an Acarigua parcel feature response. No parcel geometry or attributes were retained.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Alcaldía de Páez, Dirección de Catastro, Acarigua; official page assigns property registration, cadastral solvencies, valuations, and urban control.
sourceAssessment.publicService: No public local parcel service was identified. IGVSB national cartographic/Mapoteca routes were inspected but did not provide a parcel feature response for Acarigua.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: No parcel layer schema or native parcel fields were observed.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite parcel identity was constructed because no feature response or schema was obtained.
